_readme: sigom-box-acc-configs-agent phase 2 (ADR 0022): copy to <run>/03-sql/acc-values.json and fill it from the gap run's evidence and the operator's answers - every entry with its source. scripts/render_acc_sql.py renders the SQL from it; nothing else is read. Keys starting with _ are comments.

owners._comment: FK_OWNER_OBJ per table - built in (box-acc-model.md section 2, A-P2): T_BOX_ACCT_PORT_PROP_S 35000170.65, T_BOX_CONF_LO_PROP_S and T_BOX_LINK_ARRAY_X 35000194.65, T_BOX_ACCT_GLTA_S 35000169.65 (and its date rules T_BOX_ACCT_PARENT_DATE_S: extension 35001497.65 of the account), T_BOX_ACCT_TOPICS_S 35000179.65, T_BOX_ACCT_HISTSTD 35000180.65, T_BOX_CROSS_ACCTCONF_S 35000189.65, T_BOX_CONF_INSTRUM_TYPE_S 35000292.65, T_BOX_NETCCS_BSPLAN_S 35000348.65. Override here only if A-P2 shows another value in the target.

sequences._comment: default BOX_ACC.SPK_<table>; a table whose sequence has another name (A-P5, BOX dev): OWNER.NAME

global_pk._comment: global objects take .65 PKs (ADR 0018): start = the first number of the range the BOX team agreed, or "next-free" in a DEV environment only (the highest .65 + 1, read when the block runs)

row._comment: every other column from the A-P7 column map

global_topics.source: <A-06 / A-U7a file:line - GBO topic with no BOX CODE twin (ADR 0018)>

row._comment: every other column from the A-P7 / A-10c column map (copied from GBO); FK_GLTATYPE / FK_DIRECTION = the BOX values of the GBO codes (A-10a codes -> A-10e); never a column BOX sets itself (LOC_CODE, HOSTINTERFIND, STATUS, MESSAGE, VALIDDATE, PARENT_ACCOUNT, LSTMNT*) - refused as column-computed [ADR 0023]

accounts.source: <A-10a file:line - or, for a Net CCS account (BOX-side technical, no GBO row), A-13a file:line (the reference's BOX row)>

_not_carried.what: <e.g. GBO 2214.35 / clash group C2 / Net CCS row naming FFM>
_not_carried.why: <held (clash mode a, no choice) / OPEN: condition value with no BOX value / OPEN: account no source has / out of scope>
_not_carried.source: <the matrix / report line, the question number>

local_properties.source: <ADR 0020: the in-scope GBO properties' topics (A-04e, by CODE) and their conditions with a BOX twin (condition map)>

existing_local_properties._comment: instrument PK -> the arrays of a local property the target's group already has (A-02c) - only when not created here

portfolio_properties.description: <the GBO property's description, as it is>
portfolio_properties.source: <A-04d / A-04e / A-04f file:line; condition map; decisions.pp_clash_choices / multi_account_topics>
